sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII — MEPF Coordination with Architecture
sources.description: Requires integrated design approach: building structure and systems must be coordinated to avoid conflicts. Clearance requirements for MEPF routing through structural members.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule IX — Sanitary and Plumbing Coordination Standards
sources.description: Plumbing coordination requirements: pipe routing, sleeve installation, fire-stopping at penetrations, and clearance from electrical systems.

sources.label: PEC 2017 Part 1, Article 3.00 — Wiring Methods: Clearance and Coordination Requirements
sources.description: Minimum clearance requirements for electrical conduit from other MEPF systems, structural members, and building elements.
